title: Milk-chan Totem
description: Replaces the Totem of Undying with Milk-chan from the game "milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk"
body:
![Milk-chan Totem!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f423301023fe7606c30ef4bbda287da4c9fa74b6.png)

<details>
<summary>RU</summary>

Устали от старого тотема бессмертия и вы фанат игры "milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk"? Вы нашли то что искали! Этот ресурс пак изменит старый тотем бессмертия на милк-тян, так же изменён звук тотема на звук из игры. O!

</details>


<details>
<summary>EN</summary>

Tired of the old Totem of Undying? A fan of the game *milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk*? You’ve found exactly what you were looking for! This resource pack replaces the old Totem of Undying with Milk-chan and changes the totem's sound effect to one from the game. O!

</details>
